sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The unit generators are cynch. Generator has 11 kv 
generated 3937 amp 100 rpm, 50 HZ and 0.9 power factor

The generators has self excitation 240 v and 795 
amp. (static exc)

The first draft was initiated by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Wahab El Dardir, accepted by general director eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Abd El 
Dayem, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam 
(1&2) power stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC MPIS 
coordinatori and inspection & quality control general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one who is
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ... 
 etc
The generator unit must be isolated (unit off)
The generator unit circuit breaker must be racked out
Switch on the unit earth (G -ES)
Switch off the DC excitayion

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the rotor wdg 
insulation resistance.

Check wear of brake lining 
and ring.

Check balancing exhaust air 
temp.
Check oil vapour separator.

Check shaft current 
preventive insulation.

Using megger 500 v and 
before maintenance measure the rotor winding insulation.

Check the brushes, 
brushholders and exciter filter.

Inspect under rotor, 
inspect for brake ring & brake equipment.

Reverse water circulation 
in generator pit for generator coolers.
Check all piping & valves.

Check after maintenance 
the rotor wdg. insulation.
